component.name: Harish Code
component.summary: Harish Code, the open source coding agent

description.p: Harish Code is a desktop AI coding agent that helps you write, review and run code with any model — including bundled free models and local Ollama models.
It is an independent, rebranded distribution of the MIT-licensed OpenCode desktop application. See NOTICE for the full attribution.
Initial Harish Code distribution, tracking OpenCode 2.2.0.
